note: Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/ua-wallet-vectors.mjs (ua-rs-sign T1a) from src/uakey.js and src/seed.js; never edit by hand. UA keys: the UA tree m/7622'/0'/<account>'/<kindNo>'/<i>' (kindNo = the kind number in decimal; BIP-32 secp256k1 for 0x0103 / 0x0108 / 0x0110, SLIP-10 nist256p1 for 0x0101, SLIP-10 ed25519 for 0x0102, all hardened), the EIP-2333 UA paths m/254/0/<account>/<kindNo> (bn254, salt "SCAAS-UA-BN254-v1": 0x0104, 0x0107, 0x0112 at 274) and m/12381/0/<account>/<kindNo> (BLS12-381, EIP-2333's salt: 0x0105, 0x0106), index 0 only, and the PQ HKDF seeds of pq.js. keyData: the kind's key data; a MuSig2 participant (0x0110: 33-byte compressed key, 0x0112: bn254 G1) has ua null (the group is the UA). account, index and coinType < 2^31. Seeds: BIP-39 with NFKD of the words and of the passphrase.
